mapper.insert: insert into auth_session (session_id, token_family_id, principal_type, principal_id, refresh_token_hash, status, expires_at, last_used_at, revoked_at, revoke_reason, ip_hash, device_summary, create_time, update_time) values (#{sessionId}, #{tokenFamilyId}, #{principalType}, #{principalId}, #{refreshTokenHash}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{lastUsedAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{revokeReason}, #{ipHash}, #{deviceSummary}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update auth_session set status = 'ROTATED', last_used_at = #{now}, update_time = #{now} where session_id = #{sessionId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and expires_at > #{now}
update auth_session set status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = #{now}, revoke_reason = #{reason}, update_time = #{now} where session_id = #{sessionId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
update auth_session set status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = #{now}, revoke_reason = #{reason}, update_time = #{now} where token_family_id = #{familyId} and status in ('ACTIVE', 'ROTATED')

update auth_session set status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = #{now}, revoke_reason = #{reason}, update_time = #{now} where principal_type = #{principalType} and principal_id = #{principalId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
update auth_session set status = 'EXPIRED', update_time = #{now} where status = 'ACTIVE' and expires_at <= #{now}
mapper.delete: delete from auth_session where status in ('ROTATED', 'REVOKED', 'EXPIRED') and update_time < #{cutoff} order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.select: select sum(case when status = 'ACTIVE' then 1 else 0 end) active, sum(case when status = 'ROTATED' then 1 else 0 end) rotated, sum(case when status = 'REVOKED' then 1 else 0 end) revoked, sum(case when status = 'EXPIRED' then 1 else 0 end) expired from auth_session
